title: FAA UAP reports, batch 15 (237UAP00362 - 237UAP00388)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA UAP incident reports; most entries are distant sightings, but one report describes a stationary boomerang-shaped object observed by facility staff.

encounters.summary: Facility observed a stationary boomerang-shaped object 4 NM SW of SWF for 50 minutes.
